explicit_validation.explanation: The paper conducts both LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluations but does not directly compare or validate LLM judgments against human judgments. LLM evaluation focuses on similarity analysis (linguistic style and therapy technique) and model evaluation metrics, while human evaluation assesses dataset quality and ablation studies, but no quantitative comparison between LLM and human scores is reported.

prompts.notes: Full prompts are provided in appendix figures including similarity analysis prompts (Figure 17), model evaluation prompts (Figures 19-22), with detailed evaluation standards and scoring rubrics shown

guidelines.notes: Detailed evaluation metrics and scoring scales provided in main text (Table 5), including specific dimensions and scoring criteria

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluation focuses mainly on similarity and professional metrics, while human evaluation assesses broader counseling dimensions including relationship building and fidelity. Some overlap exists in conversation strategy and attitude assessment.
